{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-la-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"79b390392c7ff483d276277f432da2c18ac5a9f311be7bf6ca767954e28256b6","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-la-class-std:lineage:33","source_registry_sha256":"8fb2294cb50570a3a0fabb25acba3418dba999eb7dd305cc58b73fdf38975613","source_liveness_sha256":"1105a92b5841d065519de4b7fbea05111880de6d2bb8804066a972d19c63b5a0"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Observation, spacing, parking and passing restrictions","heading":"Observation, spacing, parking and passing restrictions","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"# Observation, spacing, parking and passing restrictions

FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A01
The guide recommends expanding the basic following interval to four seconds in poor weather or on wet pavement. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A01
When a vehicle enters the following gap, fall back to restore safe space. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A01
Leave more space on slippery roads because the vehicle needs farther to stop. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A01
Provide extra following room behind a motorcycle because the rider might fall. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A01
Leave added room behind a large vehicle that hides the road ahead or whose driver may not see a vehicle close behind. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A01
Towing a trailer adds combined weight and increases stopping distance. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A01
Poor visibility and darkness call for additional following space. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A01
Leave extra space behind emergency vehicles so they have room to operate. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A01
Expect some buses and hazardous-material vehicles to stop at railroad tracks and leave additional room behind them. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A01
When stopped on an incline, allow for the possibility that the vehicle ahead may roll backward as it starts. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R11 | anchor: A01
Going around the block is preferable to turning around on a busy street. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R12 | anchor: A02
The guide limits a three-point turnabout to a two-lane roadway where a U-turn will not fit and going around the block is unavailable. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R13 | anchor: A02
The guide recommends applying the parking brake whenever parking, on level ground as well as on hills. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R14 | anchor: A02
In an automatic vehicle, the parking brake supplements rather than replaces selecting park. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R15 | anchor: A02
The guide recommends setting the parking brake with the service brake still depressed before selecting park. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R16 | anchor: A03
Release the parking brake before driving away. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R17 | anchor: A03
When parking downhill beside a curb, point the front wheels toward the curb. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R18 | anchor: A03
When parking uphill beside a curb, point the front wheels away from the curb. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R19 | anchor: A03
Without a curb, turn the wheels toward the road edge whether the parked vehicle faces uphill or downhill. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R20 | anchor: A03
Use the parking brake and an appropriate parked gear so the vehicle does not roll into traffic. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R21 | anchor: A03
When entering an angled parking space, check traffic, signal, slow and leave room for nearby vehicles. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R22 | anchor: A04
Before reversing from a parking space, check for obstructions and traffic in every direction. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R23 | anchor: A04
Move slowly when reversing from between parked vehicles because the view of approaching traffic is limited. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R24 | anchor: A04
During a reversing turn, the vehicle’s front end swings opposite the direction in which the rear is turning. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R25 | anchor: A04
The guide prefers backing into or pulling through a perpendicular parking space when possible. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R26 | anchor: A04
The guide’s parallel-parking instructions leave at least two feet between bumpers and adjacent vehicles unless markings indicate otherwise. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R27 | anchor: A04
Brake lights, reverse lights, a signal or outward-turned front wheels can warn that a parked vehicle is about to move. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R28 | anchor: A05
Watch for a door opening and for people or bicycles emerging between parked vehicles. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R29 | anchor: A05
The guide requires right-side wheels to be within eighteen inches of the right curb when parallel parked. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R30 | anchor: A05
Before leaving a parked vehicle unattended, shut off the engine, remove the key, lock the ignition and set the brake. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R31 | anchor: A05
Before opening a street-side door, check for passing vehicles and bicycles. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R32 | anchor: A05
Do not park on a sidewalk, across a driveway, within an intersection or in a bicycle lane. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R33 | anchor: A05
The guide prohibits parking within fifteen feet of a hydrant or fifty feet of a railroad crossing. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R34 | anchor: A05
The guide prohibits parking within twenty feet of a crosswalk at an intersection. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R35 | anchor: A05
The guide prohibits parking within twenty feet of a fire-station driveway on its side of the street or seventy-five feet on the opposite side. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R36 | anchor: A05
Double parking and parking on bridges, overpasses or inside tunnels are prohibited in the guide. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R37 | anchor: A05
Do not park where official signs prohibit it or where the vehicle would obstruct a construction area. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R38 | anchor: A05
The guide prohibits parking within twenty feet of a roadside signal, stop sign or yield sign. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R39 | anchor: A05
A white curb denotes short stops; yellow denotes loading or another restriction. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R40 | anchor: A05
Red curb paint indicates fire-related restrictions, and blue identifies an accessibility restriction. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R41 | anchor: A05
An access aisle beside accessible parking provides space for loading equipment and entering or leaving the vehicle. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R42 | anchor: A06
Use an accessible parking space only with the required authorization. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec08-R43 | anchor: A06
Do not block the intended use of an access aisle, including by leaving a cart or motorcycle in it. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec08-R44 | anchor: A06
Unauthorized use of accessible parking or its access aisle can result in towing and related costs. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec08-R45 | anchor: A06
A left-side pass must not force an approaching driver or the passed driver to slow or leave the road. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec08-R46 | anchor: A06
The guide requires completing a pass before coming within one hundred feet of an opposing vehicle. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec08-R47 | anchor: A06
Do not pass with a view blocked by a hill or bend, across a solid yellow line on the driver’s side, or on the shoulder. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec08-R48 | anchor: A06
The guide bars passing within one hundred feet of a junction, railroad crossing, bridge or tunnel. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0076]
